verdict.rationale: AWS provides generic building blocks that can be used to create an isolated test environment separate from production — Free Tier accounts explicitly pitched for 'building and breaking things' without charges (aws-docs-18, aws-docs-30), and CloudFormation stacks that can be created and deleted cleanly (aws-docs-6, aws-docs-7) plus IAM roles/policies for access isolation (aws-docs-10, aws-docs-12). However there is no dedicated 'sandbox environment' product or AI-native testing feature documented. missing for 10: a named sandbox/staging environment product, explicit guidance on isolating test vs production data, and any AI-agent-specific sandbox testing workflow.
